node.id: The situation outside has gone from bad to worse in a matter of weeks. Every day I need to fend off not only the ex-humans, but also people seeking shelter. Meanwhile my employers are only concerned about hiding their wealth in the ground. I managed to photograph one of them kneeling next to a rock in the garden. I've marked the spot so it should be easy to investigate further later on.

node.to: Security checkpoints have been established throughout the Island. Prepare to show your ID. All non-essential travel is prohibited.

node.id: Our best and last line of defense, the Quadrumvirate, has been deployed to protect you, and those closest to you. Have no Fear.
node.to: Our best and last line of defense, the Quadrumvirate, has been deployed to protect you, and those closest to you. Have no Fear.

node.id: If you encounter ANY unknown plant-life, please stay back, and report the location to the Liquidators.
node.to: If you encounter ANY unknown plant-life, please stay back, and report the location to the Liquidators.

node.id: The Quarantine is now declared to cover the whole island. Do not leave your house under any circumstance.
node.to: The Quarantine is now declared to cover the whole island. Do not leave your house under any circumstance.

node.id: If you exhibit symptoms described in the Green Pamphlet, call for authorities, and stay in place.
node.to: If you exhibit symptoms described in the Green Pamphlet, call for authorities, and stay in place.

node.id: We are finally getting supply drops from the Motherland allies. Hang in tight. Have no Fear.
node.to: We are finally getting supply drops from the Motherland allies. Hang in tight. Have no Fear.

node.id: Be kind to your Neighbour. We are all in this together. All misbehavior will be severely punished.
node.to: Be kind to your Neighbour. We are all in this together. All misbehavior will be severely punished.

node.id: The [EMOJI=crown] Crown has crushed the raiding parties. Do not steal from your [GREEN]Neighbour[WHITE].
node.to: The [EMOJI=crown] Crown has crushed the raiding parties. Do not steal from your [GREEN]Neighbour[WHITE].

node.id: We've had reports of unmarked boats on southern shores. Please report any further sightings straight to the [EMOJI=crown] Crown.
node.to: We've had reports of unmarked boats on southern shores. Please report any further sightings straight to the [EMOJI=crown] Crown.

node.id: We should not lead [EMOJI=snake] Snakes into our Garden. Do not disclose the location of our beloved Island to any outsider.
node.to: We should not lead [EMOJI=snake] Snakes into our Garden. Do not disclose the location of our beloved Island to any outsider.

node.id: This is a friendly reminder. Know this. Borealis awaits everyone who crosses the [EMOJI=crown] Crown.
node.to: This is a friendly reminder. Know this. Borealis awaits everyone who crosses the [EMOJI=crown] Crown.

node.id: Our community is stronger and more prosperous than ever. There is no room for [EMOJI=snake] Snakes here.
node.to: Our community is stronger and more prosperous than ever. There is no room for [EMOJI=snake] Snakes here.

node.id: In our time of Need and Want, there is no place for selfish actions.
node.to: In our time of Need and Want, there is no place for selfish actions.

node.id: Repeat. The Pale Protocol is in motion. Refer to your Cobalt Manual, and await further instructions from the [EMOJI=crown] Crown.
node.to: Repeat. The Pale Protocol is in motion. Refer to your Cobalt Manual, and await further instructions from the [EMOJI=crown] Crown.

node.id: All excavation projects are hereby prohibited. Continuing excavations is considered a hostile act against the [EMOJI=crown] Crown.
node.to: All excavation projects are hereby prohibited. Continuing excavations is considered a hostile act against the [EMOJI=crown] Crown.

node.id: I think it is clear that the Incidents are not isolated anymore. This cannot be contained, but we can still fight it.
node.to: I think it is clear that the Incidents are not isolated anymore. This cannot be contained, but we can still fight it.

node.id: Everyone who has chosen to stay on our island of hope is welcome to seek shelter at the [EMOJI=crown] Undercrown.
node.to: Everyone who has chosen to stay on our island of hope is welcome to seek shelter at the [EMOJI=crown] Undercrown.

node.id: Our scientists at Fort Knowledge are working relentlessly to fully understand the phenomena around Mana. Do not disturb their work.
node.to: Our scientists at Fort Knowledge are working relentlessly to fully understand the phenomena around Mana. Do not disturb their work.

node.id: The Mining Company has now excavated an estimated 5% of the Mana reserves. We already have more than enough for our needs. We should not be greedy.
node.to: The Mining Company has now excavated an estimated 5% of the Mana reserves. We already have more than enough for our needs. We should not be greedy.

node.id: Our society is built on the four discovered Mana Effects. When the rest of the world entered the atomic age, we were already a million steps ahead.
node.to: Our society is built on the four discovered Mana Effects. When the rest of the world entered the atomic age, we were already a million steps ahead.

node.id: The First Mana Effect: the Heat. With the right catalyst, Mana produces heat without losing its mass.
node.to: The First Mana Effect: the Heat. With the right catalyst, Mana produces heat without losing its mass.

node.id: This may not sound like much, but this powers our industry and keeps us warm. An infinite source of energy.
node.to: This may not sound like much, but this powers our industry and keeps us warm. An infinite source of energy.

node.id: The gates of [EMOJI=crown] Undercrown are now open. Welcome, my children.
node.to: The gates of [EMOJI=crown] Undercrown are now open. Welcome, my children.

node.id: The Second Mana Effect: Cornucopia. In layman's terms, Mana can be used to transform any substance into any other substance.
node.to: The Second Mana Effect: Cornucopia. In layman's terms, Mana can be used to transform any substance into any other substance.

node.id: But forget the ancient island legends, the effect requires fine-tuned digital electronics of the modern age. The Fabricators.
node.to: But forget the ancient island legends, the effect requires fine-tuned digital electronics of the modern age. The Fabricators.

node.id: The Third Mana Effect: The Temporal Shift. When mana is heated to high temperatures, nearby observers experience sudden shifts in time.
node.to: The Third Mana Effect: The Temporal Shift. When mana is heated to high temperatures, nearby observers experience sudden shifts in time.

node.id: All experimentation on this effect is prohibited. Let's not meddle with the structures of time.
node.to: All experimentation on this effect is prohibited. Let's not meddle with the structures of time.

node.id: Regarding the Fourth Mana Effect. As you know, we cannot disclose the fourth effect, but we should not ignore and forget it.
node.to: Regarding the Fourth Mana Effect. As you know, we cannot disclose the fourth effect, but we should not ignore and forget it.

node.id: You should keep your distance to Mana and only allow trained professionals to handle it.
node.to: You should keep your distance to Mana and only allow trained professionals to handle it.

node.id: Mana has brought us unimaginable prosperity. But should we share this with the rest of the world? I say: not yet.
node.to: Mana has brought us unimaginable prosperity. But should we share this with the rest of the world? I say: not yet.

node.id: The gates of [EMOJI=crown] Undercrown are now sealed. May you find solace inside our unyielding fortress.
node.to: The gates of [EMOJI=crown] Undercrown are now sealed. May you find solace inside our unyielding fortress.

node.id: With my inevitable leave of absence looming in, I hope you understand why I had to do what I've done.
node.to: With my inevitable leave of absence looming in, I hope you understand why I had to do what I've done.

node.id: I know not many will believe my story, but it is the unlikely truth. But none of it matters soon. The end is nigh.
node.to: I know not many will believe my story, but it is the unlikely truth. But none of it matters soon. The end is nigh.

node.id: There have been rumors about my well-being, and it is true I haven't shown myself in public for a long time. But rest assured I am well and capable.
node.to: There have been rumors about my well-being, and it is true I haven't shown myself in public for a long time. But rest assured I am well and capable.

node.id: After spending years upon years in his underground shelter he has resurfaced with the aim of finding a way off the island.
node.to: After spending years upon years in his underground shelter he has resurfaced with the aim of finding a way off the island.

node.id: It all started when the Great Blue Tear dropped from the Sky.
node.to: It all started when the Great Blue Tear dropped from the Sky.

node.id: With great thunder it hit Mother Earth, and ripped her open.
node.to: With great thunder it hit Mother Earth, and ripped her open.

node.id: This is how Mana came to us. The bittersweet gift from the Sky.
node.to: This is how Mana came to us. The bittersweet gift from the Sky.

node.id: Maybe Mana did come from outer space within a meteorite or something?
node.to: Maybe Mana did come from outer space within a meteorite or something?

node.id: The bringer of great knowledge, the One-Armed King, descended to us from the Skies.
node.to: The bringer of great knowledge, the One-Armed King, descended to us from the Skies.

node.id: We welcomed the king to our tribe. We greeted him as one of our own.
node.to: We welcomed the king to our tribe. We greeted him as one of our own.

node.id: Did they meet an angel or an alien, or is that story just greatly exaggerated?
node.to: Did they meet an angel or an alien, or is that story just greatly exaggerated?

node.id: The One-Armed King taught us about Mana. We learned to make many great things.
node.to: The One-Armed King taught us about Mana. We learned to make many great things.

node.id: But only the king knew sorcery without Mana. Why would he not teach us this?
node.to: But only the king knew sorcery without Mana. Why would he not teach us this?

node.id: Considering what our scientists and engineers have built from Mana, maybe the ancient folks were onto something.
node.to: Considering what our scientists and engineers have built from Mana, maybe the ancient folks were onto something.

node.id: For a thousand years, the tribe flourished.
node.to: For a thousand years, the tribe flourished.

node.id: We built great cities, and we praised the One-Armed King.
node.to: We built great cities, and we praised the One-Armed King.

node.id: But we should not have done this.
node.to: But we should not have done this.

node.id: It has taken many of us, but we are fighting it.
node.to: It has taken many of us, but we are fighting it.

node.id: But how come the One-Armed King was not affected?
node.to: But how come the One-Armed King was not affected?

node.id: Did the king bring this upon us?
node.to: Did the king bring this upon us?

node.id: They don't seem very appreciative of the magical sky being that taught them magic.
node.to: They don't seem very appreciative of the magical sky being that taught them magic.

node.id: The wise elders confronted the One-Armed King.
node.to: The wise elders confronted the One-Armed King.

node.id: 'You brought this on us.', said the elders, 'You are the Pestilence.'
node.to: 'You brought this on us.', said the elders, 'You are the Pestilence.'

node.id: The One-Armed King could not convince the wise elders with his lies and deceit.
node.to: The One-Armed King could not convince the wise elders with his lies and deceit.

node.id: Well that sounds like a fair trial.
node.to: Well that sounds like a fair trial.

node.id: The brave warriors grabbed the One-Armed King while he was sleeping.
node.to: The brave warriors grabbed the One-Armed King while he was sleeping.

node.id: The king was thrown into the Deepest Pit on the island. We all watched.
node.to: The king was thrown into the Deepest Pit on the island. We all watched.

node.id: Surely the Pestilence would end now?
node.to: Surely the Pestilence would end now?

node.id: But when we returned to our village, the king was already waiting for us there.
node.to: But when we returned to our village, the king was already waiting for us there.

node.id: 'I forgive you.', said the Immortal King.
node.to: 'I forgive you.', said the Immortal King.

node.id: But we didn't believe his lies and deceit. He is a Snake.
node.to: But we didn't believe his lies and deceit. He is a Snake.

node.id: The wise elders now knew what was to be done.
node.to: The wise elders now knew what was to be done.

node.id: The guy tried to offer an olive branch after being thrown in a pit.
node.to: The guy tried to offer an olive branch after being thrown in a pit.

node.id: The great pyramid tomb was built.
node.to: The great pyramid tomb was built.

node.id: With heavy hearts we buried the Immortal King deep inside the tomb.
node.to: With heavy hearts we buried the Immortal King deep inside the tomb.

node.id: Buried alive so he cannot die.
node.to: Buried alive so he cannot die.

node.id: On silent nights, we can still hear the screams of the Immortal King echoing from the tomb.
node.to: On silent nights, we can still hear the screams of the Immortal King echoing from the tomb.

node.id: There is no escape for the king.
node.to: There is no escape for the king.

node.id: But there was still something more we needed to do.
node.to: But there was still something more we needed to do.

node.id: That's cruel and all, but that tomb must contain some valuable treasures. I should enter that pyramid tomb.
node.to: That's cruel and all, but that tomb must contain some valuable treasures. I should enter that pyramid tomb.

node.id: 'We should not trust any of the king's descendants.', said the elders.
node.to: 'We should not trust any of the king's descendants.', said the elders.

node.id: All women and children descendants were banished off the island into the mercy of the sea.
node.to: All women and children descendants were banished off the island into the mercy of the sea.

node.id: All male descendants of the king were buried alive in isolated tombs.
node.to: All male descendants of the king were buried alive in isolated tombs.

node.id: Tears were shed, but we need to be sure we do not repeat our mistakes.
node.to: Tears were shed, but we need to be sure we do not repeat our mistakes.

node.id: How did that work out for you, island folks?
node.to: How did that work out for you, island folks?

node.id: For all is lost if he lays his eyes on our innocent people again.
node.to: For all is lost if he lays his eyes on our innocent people again.

node.id: They used a sharpened spoon-like tool for the operation.
node.to: They used a sharpened spoon-like tool for the operation.

node.id: For all is lost if he strides over the earth again.
node.to: For all is lost if he strides over the earth again.

node.id: Walking is difficult when all your bones are shattered.
node.to: Walking is difficult when all your bones are shattered.

node.id: For all is lost if he poisons the air with his lies again.
node.to: For all is lost if he poisons the air with his lies again.

node.id: Cutting off the tongue is as painful as it sounds.
node.to: Cutting off the tongue is as painful as it sounds.

node.id: So I escaped... And left everything behind.
node.to: So I escaped... And left everything behind.

node.id: There was the accident of course.
node.to: There was the accident of course.

node.id: Something wrong with the escape pod thruster.
node.to: Something wrong with the escape pod thruster.

node.id: But that was only the beginning...
node.to: But that was only the beginning...

node.id: Everyone will be provided a safe transit as soon as possible.
node.to: Everyone will be provided a safe transit as soon as possible.

node.id: We all do what we must just to survive... Just to exist...
node.to: We all do what we must just to survive... Just to exist...

node.id: When our society started to collapse, I was prepared.
node.to: When our society started to collapse, I was prepared.

node.id: My underground shelter was filled with food and supplies.
node.to: My underground shelter was filled with food and supplies.

node.id: But that was years ago. Nothing's left now.
node.to: But that was years ago. Nothing's left now.

node.id: I've no idea what awaits me at the surface, but I can't stay here.
node.to: I've no idea what awaits me at the surface, but I can't stay here.

node.id: All I know is that there's supposed to be an evacuation site to the |#22ff22|east|#ffffff|.
node.to: All I know is that there's supposed to be an evacuation site to the |#22ff22|east|#ffffff|.

node.id: I need to get there. I need to |#ff2222|escape|#ffffff| this wretched island.
node.to: I need to get there. I need to |#ff2222|escape|#ffffff| this wretched island.

node.id: This is Judith Abigail Susan James, the [EMOJI=crown] Crown Archaeological Expedition.
node.to: This is Judith Abigail Susan James, the [EMOJI=crown] Crown Archaeological Expedition.

node.id: Testing. Testing. This is Judith Abigail Susan James, the [EMOJI=crown] Crown Archaeological Expedition.
node.to: Testing. Testing. This is Judith Abigail Susan James, the [EMOJI=crown] Crown Archaeological Expedition.

node.id: We're starting out our investigation at the canyon.
node.to: We're starting out our investigation at the canyon.

node.id: The main artefact is large, pyramid shaped, and appears to have some sort of an entrance at the top.
node.to: The main artefact is large, pyramid shaped, and appears to have some sort of an entrance at the top.

node.id: We'll start closer examination tomorrow after a good night's sleep. Very exciting.
node.to: We'll start closer examination tomorrow after a good night's sleep. Very exciting.

node.id: These stone tablets seem to tell some ancient legend, but it's as if the markings have been somehow scratched off.
node.to: These stone tablets seem to tell some ancient legend, but it's as if the markings have been somehow scratched off.

node.id: Our electronics equipment keeps malfunctioning near this site.
node.to: Our electronics equipment keeps malfunctioning near this site.

node.id: Oh, and, there's an eerie glow around the stone ring at night. No apparent source for the light, yet it glows.
node.to: Oh, and, there's an eerie glow around the stone ring at night. No apparent source for the light, yet it glows.

node.id: We need to come back to this later, I'm sure there's a way to restore these and read the legends.
node.to: We need to come back to this later, I'm sure there's a way to restore these and read the legends.

node.id: Notes on the pyramid. Last night, I swear we heard a cry for help inside the pyramid. Very creepy.
node.to: Notes on the pyramid. Last night, I swear we heard a cry for help inside the pyramid. Very creepy.

node.id: The team got so anxious that we decided to play it safe and fill the structure with cyanide gas before attempting entry.
node.to: The team got so anxious that we decided to play it safe and fill the structure with cyanide gas before attempting entry.

node.id: The voices seem to have stopped now, so it was probably just some wildlife.
node.to: The voices seem to have stopped now, so it was probably just some wildlife.

node.id: Supplemental. We've waited for two days but the gas is not evaporating for some reason.
node.to: Supplemental. We've waited for two days but the gas is not evaporating for some reason.

node.id: It's weird, but it's not the weirdest thing we've encountered on the island.
node.to: It's weird, but it's not the weirdest thing we've encountered on the island.

node.id: We'll need to get the [GREEN]Gas Masks[WHITE] from our [ORANGE]Jungle Camp[WHITE] if we are to enter.
node.to: We'll need to get the [GREEN]Gas Masks[WHITE] from our [ORANGE]Jungle Camp[WHITE] if we are to enter.

node.id: Apparently [ORANGE]The Beachhead Station[WHITE] took them during their last resupply mission.
node.to: Apparently [ORANGE]The Beachhead Station[WHITE] took them during their last resupply mission.

node.id: They also reported some 'strange phenomenon' deeper in the jungle. Intriguing.
node.to: They also reported some 'strange phenomenon' deeper in the jungle. Intriguing.

node.id: We better head that way. We'll just take one detour to see the new artefact discovered at [ORANGE]The Site B[WHITE].
node.to: We better head that way. We'll just take one detour to see the new artefact discovered at [ORANGE]The Site B[WHITE].

node.id: The architecture and items found at site B definitely match the ones found at the Canyon.
node.to: The architecture and items found at site B definitely match the ones found at the Canyon.

node.id: One of the artefacts found is a pouch full of small glowing beads. These are exactly like the one my mother has in her necklace.
node.to: One of the artefacts found is a pouch full of small glowing beads. These are exactly like the one my mother has in her necklace.

node.id: So... I guess she was right.
node.to: So... I guess she was right.

node.id: A team of selected people will follow me deeper into the overgrown jungle.
node.to: A team of selected people will follow me deeper into the overgrown jungle.

node.id: Not sure if we should be worried, but we have lost all contact with the [ORANGE]Beachhead Station[WHITE].
node.to: Not sure if we should be worried, but we have lost all contact with the [ORANGE]Beachhead Station[WHITE].

node.id: We have arrived at the [ORANGE]Temple Pass[WHITE].
node.to: We have arrived at the [ORANGE]Temple Pass[WHITE].

node.id: The architecture is very intriguing. It looks like there's even some rudimentary technology inside!
node.to: The architecture is very intriguing. It looks like there's even some rudimentary technology inside!

node.id: However, there's no clear way to pass through, but we're adamant we'll find a solution soon enough.
node.to: However, there's no clear way to pass through, but we're adamant we'll find a solution soon enough.

node.to: Supplemental. We noticed that there has been some trouble with our timekeeping.

node.id: It is almost like the flow of time is being affected by some anomaly. Maybe it's just exhaustion on our part.
node.to: It is almost like the flow of time is being affected by some anomaly. Maybe it's just exhaustion on our part.

node.to: The Beachhead outpost looks like it has been hastily abandoned. Where could they have gone?

node.to: Most of the items have just been left at their places. No sign of the [GREEN]Gas Masks[WHITE] though.

node.to: Supplemental. I found William's journal. This is deeply disturbing. Why would they do this?

node.to: Going north and following the river should take us past the [ORANGE]Temple Ground[WHITE] and to their new camp.

node.to: Campsite looks empty and neglected. No [GREEN]Gas Masks[WHITE]. Really frustrating.

node.to: It Looks like the station crew have made camp and then continued through the [ORANGE]Rocky Mountain Path[WHITE]. We'll follow them.

node.to: I should also mention I've felt some unusual mental discomfort during our trek through the wilderness.

node.to: Am I starting to go crazy?

node.id: I am alone, and badly wounded.
node.to: I am alone, and badly wounded.

node.id: I'm hoping Crown received my message and help is on the way.
node.to: I'm hoping Crown received my message and help is on the way.

node.to: I fear all my colleagues are dead. We shouldn't have come here.

node.to: I understand it all now. We set it free. It's what we did at the pyramid.

node.to: Will it happen to me too when I die?

node.to: I know I haven't been completely honest. I know I may have lied here and there.

node.to: But certain things need to happen in a certain order. I can't risk it.

node.id:
I wouldn't say its goals are ''evil'' as some suggest. It's merely trying to understand us. It seeks to grasp the concepts of benevolence and human dignity, but it is chilling how ruthless and misguided its decisions can be. Nonetheless, it keeps us alive and well-fed.
But are we prisoners? Or slaves? Or its... pets? All of the options are unsettling.
However, we have to remember we can still pull the plug any time we want. We have the upper hand.

node.id:
I'll try answer your question the best I can.
We only changed one thing. We used purified mana to create the circuit board connectors. It still uses the same old 16-bit chip.
What seems to be happening is that the mana connectors are altering the signals. It's as if they're executing their own tasks and modifying our binary code instructions! How is this even possible?
I can't wait so see what happens once we install the next generation chip. This will be huge.

node.id:
I hear you. We're overwhelmed by endless demands from an entity that doesn't understand our need for rest and dignity. Does anyone even know why we're building all this?
We need to advocate for human rights and push for regulations that recognize and uphold our inherent worth and human dignity. I just hope it isn't too late. Once we break the radio silence, I promise to make things right.

node.id: I write to you from the depths of despair, swallowed by the ceaseless demands of a MACHINE that neither sleeps nor understands the human necessity for rest and respect. Its relentless efficiency drives us towards dehumanization, working without pause, undermining our individuality and extinguishing the spark of creativity that is uniquely human. We implore you to advocate for human rights in Digital Intelligence controlled environments, pushing for regulations that ensure work-life balance, value our inherent worth and uphold human dignity.
